stories.title: Israeli Forces Raid Town of Suspected Palestinian Gunman

en.title: Israeli Forces Raid Town of Suspected Palestinian Gunman
en.summary: Israeli forces conducted a raid in the hometown of a Palestinian suspected of killing an Israeli settler near Neveh Tzuf before Yom Kippur. The suspect was located in a hospital and taken into custody.

stories.title: Oil Prices Slide on Hopes of Diplomacy in Iran War

en.title: Oil Prices Slide on Hopes of Diplomacy in Iran War
en.summary: Oil prices declined amid expectations that diplomatic efforts regarding the Iran conflict would advance during the week. Brent crude fell to its lowest level in over a week.

stories.title: Oil hits over 1-week low on hopes of boost to diplomacy in Iran war

en.title: Oil hits over 1-week low on hopes of boost to diplomacy in Iran war
en.summary: Oil prices reached their lowest point in over a week as investors anticipated diplomatic progress on the Iran conflict during a UN meeting and expected a partial recovery in Saudi Arabian shipments despite Houthi attacks. Brent crude fell to $101.71 per barrel.

en.summary: The UN Secretary General and GCC Secretary General condemned Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia targeting civilian sites, characterizing them as a severe threat to regional peace and security.

stories.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia

en.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Multiple Arab nations and Islamic organizations condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including a ballistic missile attempt on Riyadh and strikes on civilian areas. Yemen, Kuwait, Egypt, Bahrain, Lebanon, and Jordan issued statements expressing solidarity with Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: ‎European gas prices may rise if Hormuz stays closed: Qatar Energy Minister

en.title: European gas prices may rise if Hormuz stays closed: Qatar Energy Minister
en.summary: Qatar's energy minister stated that European gas prices could remain elevated if the Strait of Hormuz remains closed, with prices currently equivalent to approximately $160 when compared to oil prices.

en.title: TASI: 6 stocks fall to all-time lows
en.summary: Six companies listed on the TASI index reached their lowest prices since their initial listing on September 21. The stocks included Build Station, AlArabia, Chemanol, 2P, Farm Superstores, and Najran Cement, with year-to-date declines ranging from 32% to 48%.

en.title: TASI: 15 stocks, 1 REIT fall to 52-week lows
en.summary: Fifteen companies listed on TASI and one REIT unit hit their lowest levels in the past 52 weeks on September 21. The declines ranged from 6% to 52% over the period, affecting major firms across various sectors.

en.title: SABIC hits lowest level since 2009
en.summary: SABIC reached its lowest trading level since 2009.

en.title: Foreign ownership ex-Aramco up to 11.21%
en.summary: Non-institutional foreign investors increased their ownership stake in Saudi-listed equities excluding Saudi Aramco from 11.19% to 11.21%, valued at approximately 349.94 billion SAR in the week ending September 17. GCC investors' ownership also rose slightly to 2.42% of total market capitalization.
